genomes.name: Calm Trend, Volume-Checked Dips
genomes.thesis: Any close above the 50-day mean with 20-day volatility under 22% counts as trend. The dip and thrust entries (a 1.2-sigma dip above the 200-day, a 5.3% week) are taken only on ordinary volume, under 1.28 times average, so it does not buy into a panic. It also buys a close back over the 50-day and a 9% 60-day slide. Out when volatility passes 50% or the index breaks the 50-day without being oversold; 4.2% stop, 7.3% target, 4.9% trailing stop, 13 sessions, two-session wait.

entry_rules.when: (zscore20 < -1.18 and close > sma200 or ret5 > 0.053) and volume_ratio < 1.28

genomes.rationale: Bred in the trend-plus-dip island: generation 24.
